examples.knowledge_point: Computing the Mean of a Data Set From the Sum
examples.problem: Given a data set with $12$ data points and $\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^{12} x_i = 96,$ compute $\overline{x}.$
examples.worked_solution:
If we have a data set that consists of the points $x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n,$ then the mean is denoted by $\overline{x}$ and is given by the following formula:

$$
\overline{x} = \dfrac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^n x_i
$$

Substituting $n=12$ and $\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^{12} x_i = 96,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{x} & =\frac{1}{12}\cdot 96=8.\end{aligned}
$$
